source_refs.note: Absorption and Emission Spectra: a main subheading of 18.7 Atomic Spectra, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 130-131.

blocks.text: Jab continuous spectrum wali roshni (jaise safed roshni) kam pressure wali gas se guzaar kar us ka spectrum dekhein, to kuch khaas wavelengths ki roshni missing (ghaib) milti hai aur un ki jagah dark lines hoti hain. Aise spectrum ko absorption spectrum kehte hain. Gas se guzarte waqt electrons khaas amount ki energy absorb kar ke oopar ki energy levels par chale jate hain. Sirf woh photons absorb hote hain jin ki energy bilkul utni ho jitni is chhalang ke liye chahiye. Jab yeh excited electrons neeche aate hain to unhi khaas wavelengths ke photons emit hote hain, jo emission spectrum mein nazar aate hain. Yani absorption spectrum se missing wavelengths wahi hain jo usi element ke emission spectrum mein maujood hain (Fig. 18.13).

blocks.alt: Wavelength scale (kitab ki tarah 400, 450, 500, 550, 600, 650, 650, 700 nm) par teen pattiyan: (a) continuous (lagataar) spectrum, violet se red tak poori rangon ki patti; (b) hydrogen emission spectrum, kaali patti par taqreeban 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par roshan lines; (c) hydrogen absorption spectrum, rangon ki patti jis mein inhi wavelengths par dark lines.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.13: aik hi element ke absorption aur emission spectrum ka relation (talluq): (a) safed roshni ka spectrum, (b) element ka emission spectrum, (c) usi element ka absorption spectrum (kitab ki Figure 18.13 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).
blocks.long_description: Gas bilkul wahi wavelengths absorb karti hai jo emit kar sakti hai, kyunke dono unhi energy levels ke darmiyan transitions (chhalangon) se aati hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka caption hissa (b) ko absorption aur hissa (c) ko emission spectrum kehta hai, lekin panels par ulat likha hai (b emission, c absorption); panels ke label sahi hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Atom ko excite karne ke liye photon ki energy do shells (levels) ki energy ke farq ke bilkul barabar honi chahiye: hf = Eₙ − Eₚ. Lekin electron agar atom se takraye to woh atom ko tab bhi excite kar sakta hai jab us ki K.E. is farq ke barabar ya zyada ho (bachi hui energy electron ke paas reh jati hai).

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Spectra teen qisam ke hote hain: continuous spectrum (saari rangein lagataar), line spectrum (dark patti par alag alag roshan lines, jaise garam gas ke atoms) aur band spectrum (paas paas lines ke guchhe, jo molecules dete hain).

blocks.alt: Teen leti hui pattiyan. Continuous spectrum: violet se blue, green, yellow aur orange ho kar red tak bina tootay rangon ki patti. Line spectrum: kaali patti par chaar alag roshan lines, violet, blue, green aur red. Band spectrum: rangon wali patti jis par unhi chaar jagahon par dark lines hain.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: spectra ki qismein: continuous spectrum, line spectrum aur band spectrum (kitab ke box ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wali patti mein saari rangein aik doosre mein mili hui hain, koi gap nahi: yeh continuous (lagataar) spectrum hai. Beech wali patti kaali hai aur sirf kuch khaas wavelengths par roshan lines hain: yeh line spectrum hai, jo garam gas ke atoms dete hain. Neeche wali patti mein rangein hain lekin unhi jagahon par dark lines hain jahan line spectrum mein roshan lines thin; kitab is patti ko band spectrum kehti hai.

items: Hydrogen series: Lyman (n = 1 par khatam, UV), Balmer (n = 2, visible), Paschen (n = 3, IR).
Absorption spectrum ki dark lines emission spectrum ki roshan lines ki wavelengths par hoti hain; hf = Eₙ − Eₚ.
